She kept it on her windowsill after that, next to the logbook, and some nights, when the wind howled and the light swept its slow circle over the water, she wondered who had written it, and whether they were still out there, still thinking.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光落在空荡荡的马路上，没有行人，只有偶尔驶过的清洁车缓缓碾过潮湿的路面。便利店的灯依旧明亮，玻璃门后坐着打瞌睡的店员，收银台上的小电视还在播着无人关心的新闻。远处的高楼大多熄了灯，只剩几扇窗户透出微弱的光，像是谁还没睡，或者谁又醒了。风从巷子口吹过，带着一点凉意和隔夜的饭菜味。整座城市仿佛在换气，吸一口，吐一口，安静地等待天亮。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something does a job by asking a smaller version of itself to help\n- Imagine opening a set of nested boxes: you keep opening smaller boxes until you reach the tiniest one, then you stop\n- That tiniest box is called the 'base case', and it's what keeps the whole thing from going on forever"}
